overview.description: The Invesco BulletShares 2027 Treasury Bond ETF (BSGR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks an index of US Treasury bonds maturing in 2027. The fund seeks to provide exposure to a defined-maturity Treasury bond portfolio that transitions to cash and cash equivalents as its holdings mature. BSGR was launched on Jun 10, 2026 and is issued by Invesco.
